Package com.squad93.pos.db

Class RepositoryValues

java.lang.Object
com.squad93.pos.db.RepositoryValues
final class RepositoryValues extends Object
Validates inputs against schema limits, rejecting decimals that would require rounding.

    • decimal

      static BigDecimal decimal(BigDecimal value, String label, int precision, int scale, boolean signed)
      Validates a database decimal and normalizes its scale without rounding.
      Parameters:
      value - number to validate
      label - field name used in validation messages
      precision - maximum number of digits after scale normalization
      scale - required number of fractional digits
      signed - whether negative values are allowed
      Returns:
      the value at the requested scale
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the value is null, has a forbidden sign, requires rounding, or exceeds precision
